'''Boucher's Cauldron''' is an [[alchemy]] shop located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. It's run by [[Glyx Brewright]] and [[Jaxin Chong]].

==Notes==
[[Keldric Boucher]] and [[Kyra Boucher]] are alchemist suppliers that work in [[Pestle's Apothecary]] of [[Stormwind City]].
